content.title: About
content.content: Canned pineapple in a juice pack (4024) consists of bite‑size pieces of ripe pineapple sealed in a hermetic pouch with its own juice. The product retains the bright aroma, sweet‑tart flavor, and most of the vitamins found in fresh pineapple.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Pineapple is one of the few fruits that contain bromelain – an enzyme that aids protein digestion.
Packaging in its own juice preserves up to 80 % of vitamin C compared with products processed in syrup.
Native to South America, pineapple was introduced to Europe in the 16th century.
The pouch format is convenient for long‑term storage and transport without the need for glass jars.
Pineapple is widely used in Asian and Caribbean cuisines in marinades, sauces, and desserts.

items.title: Rich in vitamin C
items.content: Vitamin C supports the immune system and acts as an antioxidant.

items.title: Contains bromelain
items.content: Bromelain helps break down proteins, improving digestion and reducing inflammation.

items.title: Source of potassium
items.content: Potassium contributes to normal heart function and blood pressure regulation.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Canned pineapple contains virtually no fat, making it suitable for low‑fat diets.

items.title: Supports digestive health
items.content: The fiber in pineapple promotes regular bowel movements and gut health.

items.title: Pineapple allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to pineapple, ranging from skin rashes to swelling.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Although packed in its own juice, the product still contains natural sugars; people with diabetes should monitor portion size.

items.title: Bromelain and medication
items.content: Bromelain can enhance the effect of anticoagulants; consult a doctor if you are taking such medication.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Pineapple juice pack can be eaten as a snack, added to fruit salads, yogurts, smoothies, desserts, or used in sauces and marinades.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the pouch in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Once opened, keep it refrigerated in a sealed container and consume within 3–4 days.
